title: SentryTower findings
description: The findings of one SentryTower run (findings.json). Version 2.x of the format: a minor version adds optional fields only. Each finding is a Finding of the National Compute data contracts, version 1 (https://nationalcompute.io/schemas/finding/1.json, vendored in src/sentrytower/contracts/schemas/finding/1.json), with the guarantees of $defs/sentrytowerFinding.

route.description: The engine that the size rule selected: funnel (1,000 files or fewer) or agent (more).

repository.description: The name of the repository folder.

result.description: The result of the run, as in run.json (status, stop_reason, stop_text, failure, spent_usd, cap_usd, units, calls, depth_factor, preview).

by_severity.description: The count of each severity that SentryTower gives; the contract's info never occurs.

sentrytowerFinding.description: What SentryTower guarantees beyond the contract Finding.

id.description: ST-001, ST-002, ... in rank order: unique in the run, not across runs.

value.description: 32 hex digits of SHA-256 over the file, the first CWE and the title words.

class.description: The blind verification never executes a claim: defective when a verified majority called the finding exploitable, else suspected.

mode.description: free-roaming: the agent session of the funnel on the whole repository; deep-check: an agent session of the funnel on one code unit; single-agent: the agent of the agent route.

rank.description: The place of the finding in the ranked output of the run.

tier.description: 1 for the findings of the standard run; 2 for further findings of a deeper run (preview: more checks; effect on findings not yet measured).

votes.description: The verdicts of the three votes of a verified slice finding of the agent route.
